featured_reviews.name: Hardik Bhatkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently purchased a Hero Xtreme 125R from this showroom. The overall experience was smooth and professional.
The vehicle was allotted within a day after clearing the payment, with no nonsense, no false promises, and clear timelines — something I really appreciated.

RTO registration was completed in just 2 days, which was very swift.

Special mention to Nelson, who was helpful and responsive throughout the purchase process.

The only hiccup I faced was on the delivery day. One of the panels had scratches, but it was replaced promptly once I raised the issue. Additionally, the delivery team needs to be more careful while cleaning the bike — the cloth used left visible scratches and swirl marks on the coloured instrument cluster, which were clearly noticeable under direct sunlight.

Apart from that, the entire buying process was good and hassle-free. I hope they continue improving these small details and maintaining their overall service quality.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thankyou so much for your Valuable Feedback.

featured_reviews.name: Aniket
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a really great experience at the dealership, and I especially want to appreciate Vishal for his outstanding service. From the very beginning till the final delivery, he was extremely professional, patient, and helpful throughout the entire process.

He explained everything clearly, guided us properly at each step, and made the whole buying experience smooth and stress-free. What truly stood out was his dedication — since I’m still learning to ride, he personally brought the scooter from the dealership to my home, which was a huge help and showed his genuine commitment towards customer satisfaction.

It’s rare to see such sincerity and support these days. Vishal truly knows what he’s doing and goes the extra mile for his customers.

featured_reviews.review_text: Automiles is one of the best places to test ride and book your hero vehicle. ALthough I live near Hero motors fort point near mahim, I traveled all the way to malad because the staff was polite and helpful. I had visited Fort point Mahim multiple times to test ride the zoom 125. But the staff were very rude and kept saying they would have no idea when the vehicle would be avaliable. They even refused any test rides as well. A big thanks to Mr Prathamesh, for arranging a test ride and also delivering the zoom 125 within 1 week.. keep up the good work .... featured_reviews.review_text: Great service by Prathamesh. Just bought xoom 125 cc zx. Best price provided across all mumbai suburb outlet. I would surely recommend you'll. I would like to thanks Prathamesh for his best service during our visit and purchase.

featured_reviews.name: Swapnil Rawool
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased a Hero Xpulse from this showroom and unfortunately my experience was extremely disappointing. The bike was delivered with an expired battery, and when I raised the concern, the showroom refused to replace it, even though the vehicle was still under warranty.

After continuous follow-up, they finally provided me with another old battery, along with only a verbal assurance that they would support me if any issue occurred — but they were not ready to provide anything in writing or email. I eventually had to escalate the issue to Hero and fight for almost two weeks just to get a proper new battery, which should have been provided in the first place.

Buying a new bike should be a smooth and trustworthy experience, but for me it became stressful and time-consuming. I hope the showroom improves their transparency, after-sales support, and customer handling. Future buyers — please check everything thoroughly before taking delivery.
